text: Welcome to the crossroads. Practice a few words, then gather what you need.
Start with greetings. A small word can open a large road.
I keep the camp supplied. Follow the tan road to the market, and use the bank before you wander too far.
Gather three Sunleaf by the south path, then come back to Mira. Keep your pack light and your eyes open.
The safe roads are marked with lamps. Past the bridge, the woods stop being polite.

choices.text: Where are the trees for woodcutting?

text: Start with the oaks near Orin. The darker pines are farther out and should become better woodcutting tiers later.
Good timber has a silhouette. Oak is broad, pine is narrow, birch is pale. If the trees all look alike, blame the foreman.
The beginner oaks are inside the lamp ring. We will reserve the taller tree-pack shapes for named woodcutting types.
